title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Guy. Part 2
body: He calls himself a nice guy in his bio. Nice guys do not need to announce it. He says "I'm not like other guys" and then does exactly what other guys do. He says "I'm very loyal" about someone he met four days ago. He hates drama and has drama with eight people. Believe what he does. Ignore what he says.
caption:
Send this to the friend who defends him.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Girl. Part 2
body: She tests you. "Do you even know what's wrong?" is not a question, it is an exam with no syllabus. She says "it's fine" and the fine is a bomb. She wants you to guess, and a wrong guess costs three days. She is not looking for a boyfriend. She is looking for a mind reader.
caption:
Tag the friend who says it's fine.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in a Rishta Meeting. Part 2
body: The aunties scan you from shoes to hair and take mental notes. "Do you cook?" means "will you cook." "Do you work?" means "will you stop working after the wedding." Smile, nod and take a samosa. Never, ever answer a question about your hobbies honestly.
caption:
Send this to someone with a rishta meeting this week.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Maybe Zone. Part 2
body: In the maybe zone, you get a reply in three hours and a heart on your story. That is the whole relationship. "Haha" is your love language. You laugh at her jokes, she laughs at yours, with a delay. It looks like progress. It is a very slow treadmill.
caption:
Send this to the friend still waiting for a reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags on a First Date. Part 2
body: He is thirty five minutes late and says "traffic." Same road you came through. The phone stays face up on the table. He answers a message mid sentence, "sorry, work," at 9pm. Then he asks why you are so quiet. You are quiet because you are calculating how to leave politely.
caption:
Which one happened to you? Be honest.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags When He Texts. Part 2
body: He says "hmm." You wrote a full paragraph about your day. "Hmm" is not a reply, it is a sigh with a keyboard. Then "k", then "ok", then a thumbs up. Each one is a small rejection in a different font. You deserve more than a letter.
caption:
Screenshot this and send it to your group chat.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Her Emotional Support Contact. Part 2
body: She only calls when something goes wrong. When something goes right, she tells her best friend. Bad news comes to you. You are the helpline, not the husband. You get the three hour crisis and none of the Eid plans. The role has no salary and no weekends.
caption:
Tag the friend who is everyone's free therapist.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Never Date a Playboy. Part 2
body: He says "you're different" and uses the same line for every girl. Same cafe, same compliment, same poem saved in his notes app. Copy paste romance. If you want proof, ask him to say something nice without looking at his phone. He will need a minute.
caption:
Tag the friend who needs this before the weekend.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in His Instagram. Part 2
body: His profile picture is a car, a sunset or the back of his head. His bio is a quote from a person he has never read. "Hustle never sleeps" and his stories start at 2pm. His highlights: Gym, Food, Dubai 2019. The only thing active on this page is his mother's like.
caption:
Check his tagged photos before you reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Taxi Light Theory. Part 2
body: Everyone in your friend group thought they were the exception. The guy who "never wanted to settle" now has a nikah date. Every serial dater is now writing wedding cards. The light came on in June. And the girl next to him was not even the one he was talking to in May.
caption:
Tag the friend whose ex got engaged in two months.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Who Has to Approve Your Marriage. Part 2
body: Chachu votes no because "we don't know the family." You have known them for thirty years. Phuppo votes no because "the girl is too modern." She wears shalwar kameez. The vote is held in the family WhatsApp group, where nobody has read the proposal and everyone is typing.
caption:
Tag someone whose rishta is stuck in committee.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Find a Spiritual Partner. Part 2
body: He is vegan this month, a monk next month. He says "I've outgrown people" and he is twenty six. He meditates for five minutes and posts about it for fifty. Silence retreat means he has blocked everyone. His morning routine: 6am cold plunge, 6:01 content.
caption:
Tag the friend who asked your moon sign on the first date.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Read a Rishta Profile. Part 2
body: Her profile says: well settled, educated, religious yet modern, tall, fair, caring, family oriented boy. In other words, a unicorn with a Toyota. "Well settled" means a house, a car and a flat in Bahria that his dad bought. Settled is a very flexible word.
caption:
Send this to a girl who has read a rishta profile.
